records.ledger_what: Documented Quickstart's undocumented `--enable-core-manual-close` flag in the advanced usage docs. The Operation Modes page now covers the flag, the `MANUAL_CLOSE` setting it writes into the generated `etc/stellar-core.cfg`, and triggering a close through the `manualclose` endpoint on port 11626, while Run Commands adds macOS, Linux, and Windows startup examples that bind the admin port to loopback. The new section also records two limits readers hit in practice: the flag is accepted on every network but only usable on local, because stellar-core checks `NODE_IS_VALIDATOR` when `manualclose` is invoked and only the local config sets it, and each invocation advances exactly one ledger.

records.ledger_what: Adds a configurable excessive code-comment verbosity check to the core review engine: `oversized_comment_block`, `excessive_comment_lines` and `comment_heavy_diff` are computed from added patch lines only, so a PR is never penalised for comments it did not touch. A single-pass lexer tracks string literals, block comments, JS and Go template literals, shell heredocs and Python triple-quoted strings, so runtime data such as a banner inside a backtick string is never counted as commentary, and hunk state established from context carrying a code token keeps a verbose block added mid-file detectable while docstring content stays excluded.
